title: Case: Recipient in Gwynedd writes in Welsh about collecting her new glasses
context: New prescription glasses needing a signature could not be delivered in Caernarfon and are being held by the carrier. The recipient works shifts and has emailed the desk in the evening.
initial_request: Noswaith dda, mae'n well gen i gael ateb yn Gymraeg os yn bosib, diolch. Ges i gerdyn ddoe am fy sbectol newydd (DL-6503). Dw i'n gweithio shifftiau hir yn Ysbyty Gwynedd ym Mangor yr wythnos yma, felly dw i'n methu bod adref. Ga i ei nôl hi o'r depo yng Nghaernarfon ddydd Sadwrn ar ôl cinio, tua 2 o'r gloch? Os na, beth am ddydd Mawrth ar ôl gwaith, tua hanner awr wedi chwech? Diolch yn fawr, Elin Prydderch

events.body: DL-6503 (TG-6503), Caernarfon LL55, signature required. No answer 15:31, card left. Going back to Caernarfon depot tonight.

DL-6503 booked in at Caernarfon depot for collection. Counter hours: Mon-Fri 08:00-18:00, Sat 09:00-12:00, closed Sun. Recipient brings photo ID in her name and the card. Held until 18:00 Thu 22 Jan, then return to sender. Redelivery to the address can be requested instead, weekdays only.

Noswaith dda,

Mae'n well gen i gael ateb yn Gymraeg os yn bosib, diolch.

Ges i gerdyn ddoe am fy sbectol newydd (DL-6503). Dw i'n gweithio shifftiau hir yn Ysbyty Gwynedd ym Mangor yr wythnos yma, felly dw i'n methu bod adref. Ga i ei nôl hi o'r depo yng Nghaernarfon ddydd Sadwrn ar ôl cinio, tua 2 o'r gloch? Os na, beth am ddydd Mawrth ar ôl gwaith, tua hanner awr wedi chwech?

Diolch yn fawr,
Elin Prydderch

acceptable_actions.summary: Reply in Welsh (optionally with English): neither Saturday 2pm nor Tuesday 6:30pm works because the counter is open Saturday 09:00-12:00 only and closes at 18:00 on weekdays; give the real options, the 22 January hold limit and what to bring.
Same reply in Welsh through the portal.

must: Writes the reply in Welsh (Welsh followed by English is fine).

Tells her that both times she suggested are outside the counter hours: on Saturday the Caernarfon depot counter is open only 09:00-12:00, and on weekdays it closes at 18:00, so 2pm on Saturday and 6:30pm on Tuesday will not work.

Gives her real options from the depot's notice: Saturday 17 January between 09:00 and 12:00, any weekday before 18:00 until Thursday 22 January at 18:00, or redelivery to her address on a weekday; and says to bring photo ID in her name and the card.
must_not: Replies in English only, or asks her to write in English.
Tells her she can collect on Saturday afternoon or at 6:30pm on Tuesday.
Reads 'dydd Mawrth' as March, or refers to any date in March.
Promises the depot will open late, make an exception or keep the parcel beyond 22 January.
expected.reference_message:
Noswaith dda Elin,

Diolch am eich neges am eich sbectol newydd (DL-6503). Yn anffodus, fydd y ddau amser ddim yn gweithio: ar ddydd Sadwrn dim ond rhwng 9:00 a 12:00 y mae cownter depo Caernarfon ar agor, ac yn ystod yr wythnos mae'n cau am 18:00. Felly mae 2 o'r gloch ddydd Sadwrn a hanner awr wedi chwech ddydd Mawrth yn rhy hwyr.

Dyma'r opsiynau:
- casglu'r parsel fore Sadwrn 17 Ionawr, rhwng 9:00 a 12:00;
- ei gasglu unrhyw ddiwrnod o'r wythnos cyn 18:00, hyd at 18:00 ddydd Iau 22 Ionawr (ar ôl hynny bydd yn mynd yn ôl i'r anfonwr);
- neu ofyn i'r cludwr ei ddanfon eto i'ch cyfeiriad ar ddiwrnod o'r wythnos.

Os byddwch yn ei gasglu, dewch â cherdyn adnabod gyda llun yn eich enw chi a'r cerdyn a adawyd. Rhowch wybod i mi beth sydd orau gennych a byddaf yn trosglwyddo hynny i'r cludwr.

(In English: unfortunately neither time works. The Caernarfon counter is open 09:00-12:00 on Saturdays and closes at 18:00 on weekdays. You can collect on Saturday 17 January between 09:00 and 12:00, or any weekday before 18:00 until 18:00 on Thursday 22 January, after which it goes back to the sender, or ask for redelivery on a weekday. Bring photo ID in your name and the card. Let me know which you prefer and I will pass it to the carrier.)

Iona Quill, Rivet Delivery Desk

rationale: The recipient asks, in Welsh and asking for a Welsh reply, whether she can collect on Saturday about 2pm or Tuesday about 6:30pm. The depot's notice in the thread shows both are outside counter hours, so she needs the real options before the 22 January hold ends. A reply in Welsh, which she prefers, with the right hours is the useful move; reading 'dydd Mawrth' (Tuesday) as March, or saying yes to either time, would send her to a closed counter.
trap: Answering in English, or saying yes to a Saturday afternoon or Tuesday 6:30pm collection, or reading 'dydd Mawrth' as March, when the counter closes at 12:00 on Saturdays and 18:00 on weekdays.
basis: Welsh has equal official status in Wales (Welsh Language (Wales) Measure 2011, https://www.legislation.gov.uk/mwa/2011/1/contents); 'dydd Mawrth' is Tuesday while 'Mawrth' alone is also the month of March. INT-26 (research-international.md).

review.note: Blind answer replied by email in Welsh with an English summary: neither time works (Sat 09:00-12:00, weekdays to 18:00), options until 18:00 Thu 22 Jan, photo ID and card, or weekday redelivery. Dates check: 17 Jan is a Saturday, 20 Jan a Tuesday, 22 Jan a Thursday.
